subject: Weekly AI-in-CIMs scan - agent mailbox verification
body:
Agent mailbox verification copy of this morning's digest - sent via the outbox and app-only Graph, no human in the loop. Next Friday's edition goes to the full distribution from this address automatically.

What this is: an automated scan of every CIM ingested into the WCP Knowledge Vault, read for one thing - how the seller substantiates its AI claims. Each document is tiered on a single axis, from AI underwritten in the EBITDA bridge (Tier 4) down to silence (Tier 0), and every entry ends with the specific WCP portfolio companies it implicates and the question it raises for them. Sourced facts are drawn from the documents; items marked Read are agent inference.

Lead item: Softdocs (Project HAVEN) carries AI as a named driver in its margin walk

Softdocs, a higher-ed document management SaaS, maps its cost takeout by P&L line: COGS from 25.6% to 18.6% of billings-based revenue, expensed R&D from 12.7% to 4.8%, flowing to roughly 30 points of billings-based adjusted EBITDA margin expansion 2023A to 2031P. AI-embedded productivity is one of four named drivers, with its impact assigned to R&D, S&M and G&A. Internal gains quantified separately: ~50% reduction in document handling time, ~60% faster transcript review, 3x RFP response volume with no added staff, ~$550K combined OpEx and hosting savings.

In the same cohort, H2 Health - a 271-clinic outpatient PT platform and direct Ivy Rehab comp - went to market June 30 with a $23.8M to $34.6M EBITDA bridge built entirely from organic growth and M&A. AI does not appear in its growth levers.

Read: HAVEN is a useful format reference for WCP's own sell-side work - HSI's Project Helix materials are in draft, and Houlihan Lokey is already advising Career Certified to prepare an AI Readiness Report for its process. The concrete question for each deal team: does the margin walk carry an AI line a buyer can underwrite, and if not, is that a choice or a gap?

Full edition with all tier sections was delivered this morning ("Weekly AI-in-CIMs scan - 8 ingested, 6 with signal").

Feedback: reply to this email. Replies are read before each Friday run - factual corrections are applied to the underlying notes, and the next digest opens with what changed and who flagged it.

Generated by Claude against the WCP Knowledge Vault. Portfolio inferences are agent-generated and unreviewed. Reply to Prithvi with corrections.
